_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (flat leg, median ~50) keeps the rung fixed; only a breaker moves it ±1.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no phase call but tone is softer/risk-off — split on urgency not on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, 30d momentum near flat, position score holds 47-54
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break lower with suppressed CVD and elevated exchange inflows pulling fear_greed through 50, or momentum+funding re-accelerating together
